name: David Villalpando
biography: David Villalpando (born January 2, 1959 in Mexico City, Mexico) is a Mexican actor. His break out role was in the film El Norte (1983). Since then he's had small roles in American films such as The Arrival, The Mask of Zorro, and the John Sayles film Men with Guns (1997). He was also in an episode in the television series Acapulco H.E.A.T., and has done a lot of work in Mexican cinema.
